title: Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)

scheme.name: Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
scheme.summary: Microfinance initiative for individual women entrepreneurs to create self-employment and make women self-reliant by providing loans to start a business of their choice.
eligibility: The applicant should belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backwards classes.
The applicant should be a woman.
The applicant's age should be between 21 and 45 years.
The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
scheme.benefits: Provides 100% of the loan amount up to ₹1,25,000/- with an interest rate of 4% per annum.
scheme.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam official website by registering, filling out the application form with required details, and submitting it.

summary.value: Microfinance initiative for individual women entrepreneurs to create self-employment and make women self-reliant by providing loans to start a business of their choice.
summary.quote: The scheme "Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Gujarat, aims to provide Microfinance for individual women entrepreneurs to create self-employment for women and make them self-reliant. Under this scheme, loans are provided on an individual basis to women beneficiaries to start a business of their choice. The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam.

how_to_apply.value: Apply online through the Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam official website by registering, filling out the application form with required details, and submitting it.
how_to_apply.quote: Step 1: Register on the Official Portal - Go to the Official Website Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam. - Scroll down on the homepage, find the "Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana" and click on "Apply Now". - You will be directed to the application form. Step 2: Access and Fill Out the Application Form - Select "Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana". - Provide Aadhaar, Ration, Voter ID, full name (Last, First, Father/Husband), address, district, taluka, village, PIN, date of birth, age, caste, subcaste, phone, mobile, email, gender, and marital status. - Enter income certificate number, issue date, issuing officer's name, total annual family income (up to ₹ 3,00,000/-), and parent/guardian's occupation. - If "Physically Handicapped," select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide the percentage (in %). - Indicate if any family member works in a government or private job. If "Yes," provide their Name, Designation, Place, and Salary details. - Select your Education Qualification: Uneducated, Educated, Graduation, Post Graduation, or Other Degree. - If you have taken a past loan, select "Yes" or "No". If you selected "Yes", provide loan details (date, amount, paid, remaining) and your account number. - Provide bank account number, bank name, branch name, name as per account, account type (Saving/Current), MICR code, and IFSC code. Step 3: Review and Final Submission - Carefully review each module. Use the preview option to examine the application before final submission. Fill out the provided "CAPTCHA" and Click on “Submit”.

needs_income_certificate.value: Yes, an income certificate is required and the annual family income must not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
